Modern Gypsy-jazz guitars are named in honour of Django Reinhardt and the Manouche Gypsies of Belgium and Northern France. They stemmed from an instrument which is designed by a classical guitarist and inventor named Mario Maccaferri. From 1932 to 1934, Maccaferri made instruments for Selmer who happens to be a woodwind manufacturer based in Paris. Let us talk about Building Harmonic Energy and Arpeggio Power. Building Harmonic Energy: If you wish to explore Django’s music, a good starting point is his tune is usually is the ‘Minor Swing’ or ‘Proud Mary’ of Gypsy jazz. ‘Minor Swing’ usually has a 16-bar progression that is divided into two and eight-bar sections. Usually in this style of music, one generally plays minor chords as minor-6th voicings. This gives a ‘hot’ sound and we’re in the key of A minor, so Am6 is the Im, Dm6 is the IVm, and E7 is the V chord. Therefore, instead of playing these above mentioned chords, try narrowing them down to three-note shapes which are exclusively played on the sixth, fourth, and third strings. Now you see why these shapes are same, whether you’re playing a minor 6 or a dominant 7? Arpeggio Power Now when it comes to improvising your single-note lines, know your arpeggios point first. They are crucial to Gypsy jazz. For example, try a line over Am6, which is the first chord in ‘Minor Swing’. There is a chromatic moment on the second string, and otherwise the line comes directly from an Am6 arpeggio—A, C, E, and F#. Then, if you want an authentic sound, use a quick and singing vibrato. The framework is a Dm arpeggio—D, F, and A—with extra colour which is provided by E and Eb, the 9 and b9. Then, we get some chromatic motion. We hope that these tips and tricks would help you to master Django technique so that you could make better and amazing musicians in the future.

Anonymity is the key to freedom of speech and open discussion. Without usernames, the comment is judged by its quality instead of its author, and the author speaks his mind without fear of losing his online reputation.

I have somewhat achieved this with uBlock origin, by adding these filters :

voat.co##.tooltipstered.userinfo.may-blank.author
voat.co##.may-blank.author

It's not ideal, I don't know if it works without night mode, but I feel like sharing to Voat users that would like an unrestrained experience on Voat.

Bonus : to hide your score, thus freeing yourself from reputation building and protecting :

voat.co###header-account > .logged-in > .user:nth-of-type(1)
